P1_findings.title: Cross-surface auth contamination: /api/auth/authcheck accepts kiosk-token Bearer and returns the admin user object
P1_findings.severity: P1 (production risk: LOW on dedicated kiosk; HIGH on shared/dev machines)

evidence.reproducer: 1) Login as admin in browser. 2) Navigate to /kiosk/idle. 3) SPA boots, kiosk-login succeeds → kioskToken stored. 4) Some axios call hits /api/auth/authcheck with that kioskToken Bearer. 5) Backend Auth::check() returns user.roles[0] for KioskMachine.user_id (admin id=1). 6) SPA store.auth.authStatus = true. 7) router.beforeEach sees authStatus=true and redirects via authenticatedStaffLanding() to /admin/dashboard. Customer NEVER sees /kiosk/idle.
files: resources/js/router/index.js:227-272 — beforeEach treats authStatus=true as admin without checking token type
app/Models/KioskMachine — user_id points at admin user id=1 (seed pattern)
evidence.verified_empirically: 3x with Playwright MCP — same redirect pattern. After aggressive localStorage purge, kiosk renders correctly.

P1_findings.recommended_fix: Reject kiosk-token Bearer in /authcheck (token name discriminator like channels.php pattern) OR set KioskMachine.user_id to a dedicated non-admin user. Frontend: add token-type check in authcheck callsite + skip auth state hydration when only kioskToken exists.

P1_findings.implication: Customer sees 'Suppléments' tile with 19 raw add-on items (Sauce supplémentaire, Cheddar, Œuf, etc.) which is normally a wizard-step add-on, not a standalone order. UX confusion possible. Spec mismatch requires owner reconciliation.

P1_findings.title: Boule gratinée price inconsistency: DB items table = €2.00, Vuex extras feed = €1.00
P1_findings.implication: Pricing SSOT violation. The kiosk wizard adds Boule gratinée at €1.00 to cart total instead of €2.00 → customer pays €1.00 less than menu says. NF525 + PricingService SSOT alarm: if backend recomputes from items.price (€2.00), validation will fail at order create. If backend reads from extras (€1.00), revenue loss + spec mismatch.
P1_findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile: decide canonical source for Boule gratinée price. Update items table OR update extras feed OR re-seed.

P1_findings.title: Confirmation auto-return is 30s, mission spec says 10s
P1_findings.implication: Either owner-tuned (acceptable) or spec stale. Worth owner-confirmation.
